meta.note: Generic SAE J2012 powertrain (P0xxx) codes are standardized and reliable. Triumph manufacturer-specific (P1xxx/P2xxx) entries below are sourced from official Triumph service manuals (Daytona 675, Thunderbird, 2017 Street Twin) with forum corroboration. Descriptions can still vary by model/year; unknown codes decode structurally and fall back to a generic message.
sources: Triumph Daytona 675 service manual DTC table

P0030.desc: O2 sensor heater control circuit (bank 1, sensor 1)

P0031.desc: O2 sensor heater control circuit low (bank 1, sensor 1)

P0032.desc: O2 sensor heater control circuit high (bank 1, sensor 1)

P0107.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor circuit low input

P0108.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor circuit high input

P0112.desc: Intake air temperature (IAT) sensor circuit low input

P0113.desc: Intake air temperature (IAT) sensor circuit high input

P0117.desc: Engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor circuit low input

P0118.desc: Engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor circuit high input

P0122.desc: Throttle position sensor (TPS) circuit low input

P0123.desc: Throttle position sensor (TPS) circuit high input

P0134.desc: O2 sensor circuit no activity detected (bank 1, sensor 1)

P0135.desc: O2 sensor heater circuit malfunction (bank 1, sensor 1)

P0444.desc: Evaporative emission purge control valve circuit open

P0458.desc: Evaporative emission purge control valve circuit low

P0505.desc: Idle air control (IAC) / idle speed control system malfunction

P0605.desc: Internal control module ROM error (ECU fault)

P0654.desc: Tachometer / engine RPM output circuit malfunction

P0917.desc: Gear position sensor short circuit to 5V sensor supply

P1078.desc: Exhaust control valve actuator position sensor circuit low voltage (short to ground)

P1079.desc: Exhaust control valve actuator position sensor circuit high voltage (short to Vcc)

P1080.desc: Exhaust control valve actuator mechanism malfunction

P1105.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor 1 pipe/hose malfunction (cyl 1)

P1106.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor 2 pipe/hose malfunction (cyl 2)

P1107.desc: Ambient (barometric) air pressure sensor circuit low voltage

P1108.desc: Ambient (barometric) air pressure sensor circuit high voltage / open or short
P1108.subsystem: Ambient air pressure sensor (barometric, often in airbox)

P1111.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor reverse connection

P1131.desc: Oxygen (lambda) sensor circuits reversed / reverse connection

P1135.desc: Traction control prevented due to ABS malfunction

P1201.desc: Injector 1 open circuit / short to ground

P1202.desc: Injector 2 open circuit / short to ground

P1203.desc: Injector 3 open circuit / short to ground

P1231.desc: Fuel pump relay short circuit to ground or open circuit

P1232.desc: Fuel pump relay short circuit to battery voltage

P1521.desc: CAN fault - lost communication with ABS module / ABS status error

P1552.desc: Cooling fan relay short circuit to ground or open circuit

P1553.desc: Cooling fan relay short circuit to battery voltage or over-temperature

P1576.desc: Brake 1 switch correlation error with brake switch 2

P1577.desc: Brake 2 switch correlation error with brake switch 1

P1604.desc: ECM tamper detected - return to Triumph

P1605.desc: ECM locked by the tune/calibration lock function

P1610.desc: Low fuel warning output circuit malfunction

P1619.desc: Headlamp relay short circuit to ground or open circuit

P1620.desc: Headlamp relay short circuit to battery voltage

P1628.desc: Fuel pump short circuit to ground or open circuit

P1629.desc: Fuel pump short circuit to battery voltage

P1631.desc: Fall (tip-over) detection sensor circuit low voltage / short to ground

P1632.desc: Fall (tip-over) detection sensor circuit high voltage / short to battery

P1650.desc: CAN fault - lost communication with immobiliser ECM

P1687.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor 2 low voltage

P1688.desc: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor 2 high voltage

P1695.desc: CAN fault - lost communication with instrument panel

P2100.desc: Throttle actuator control motor open circuit

P2120.desc: Twist grip position sensor 1 short circuit to ground or open circuit

P2123.desc: Twist grip position sensor 1 short circuit to battery voltage

P2135.desc: Throttle position sensor 1 correlation error with sensor 2

P2226.desc: Ambient air pressure sensor circuit open or short to 5V (newer platforms; = older P1108)

P2228.desc: Ambient air pressure sensor circuit short to ground (newer platforms; = older P1107)
